stories.title: Game Recap — Cubs 7, Braves 3
stories.angle: PCA went 4-for-4, 4 RBI, 42nd HR, 37th SB in Cubs' Game 1 win over Atlanta. PCA tied Billy Williams' franchise record for LH home runs.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Cubs 7, Braves 3.

PCA: 4-for-4, 4 RBI, HR No. 42, SB No. 37.

He tied Billy Williams' franchise record for LH home runs at Wrigley. Three steals from 40-40 history.

stories.title: PCA 40-40 Watch — 42 HR / 37 SB
stories.angle: PCA three steals from 40-40 club (6 members in MLB history, zero Cubs). Franchise-history milestone in reach with 11 games left.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
42 HR. 37 SB.

Three steals. That's all that stands between PCA and the 40-40 club — six members in MLB history, zero from Chicago.

No Cub has ever done it. He has 11 games.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB
